candidates.name: Apprise

candidates.name: ElastAlert 2

candidates.name: Keep

candidates.name: Nightingale

candidates.name: ntfy

candidates.name: OneUptime

candidates.name: OpenObserve

candidates.name: SigNoz

search_notes: Alphabetical, unranked candidate list checked on 2026-10-01 America/New_York. For every included repository, gh api repos/OWNER/REPO confirmed public visibility and archived:false, and gh api repos/OWNER/REPO/releases/latest returned a release within the 90-day window beginning 2026-07-03; each README was also checked. Apprise, Gotify, and ntfy are delivery-component candidates: grouping and silencing require an upstream alert router such as the listed Alertmanager. ElastAlert 2 requires relevant data in Elasticsearch or OpenSearch. Community/open-source editions are the scope for projects offering commercial editions; Keep's core is MIT-licensed outside ee/ ([LICENSE](https://github.com/keephq/keep/blob/main/LICENSE)). Host suitability is inferred from upstream Linux, Python, container deployment instructions, and available release artifacts; execution on WSL2 or macOS arm64 was not tested. Alerta was excluded: its latest release was [v9.1.0, 2026-03-28](https://github.com/alerta/alerta/releases/tag/v9.1.0), and its [default-branch commit](https://github.com/alerta/alerta/commit/4ac0106300cd) was dated 2026-03-30. Used 30 GitHub API calls and 8 README page fetches. Four web-search queries returned no usable results; discovery therefore relied on GitHub search and verified project sources. Exhaustiveness beyond this bounded discovery was not established. No workspace files were opened.
